newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Black Box started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Black Box started as buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said it initiated coverage of Black Box Corp with a buy rating.
-- said Black Box's product offering is the "sweet spot" of data networking and connectivity growth. The company's products are primarily network and connectivity related.
-- said cables and connectors, coupled with switches and LAN products, dominate Black Box's product mix (about 60 percent of revenues) and remain its most rapidly growing offerings.
-- said Black Box's telecommunication products and multimedia SKUs also are experiencing rapid growth.
-- set earnings estimates for fiscal 1997 and 1998 ended March at $1.39 and $1.75, respectively.
-- sees Black Box as the "premier worldwide direct catalog distributor of computer communication and connectivity products and services."
-- Black Box was up 2-3/4 to 27-3/4 in morning trading.
